From: Alex Rivera <alex@curioapps.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Curio Apps — looking for a quick demo and fit questions

Hi Kimberly,

We just completed a quick self-serve evaluation of Redwood and the team is interested in a short demo to see how we could use it for an in-app knowledge search/chat feature. A few quick details so you can route correctly: 

- Use case: embeddings + chat for product documentation and support articles (in-app experience).
- Expected traffic: pilot ~2000 users/month (~150k queries/month), peak concurrency ~40 QPS during business hours; long-term target ~3M tokens/month.
- Timeline: pilot target late Oct; production Q1 2029.

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute session that includes an engineer from our side? We're PST-based (SF). Also curious about trial sandbox limits and whether we can get a quick price range for the pilot.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Product Manager — Curio Apps
Attachments: curio_traffic_matrix.csv (see traffic sketch)

P.S. CCing Pat (CTO) to loop him in on availability.
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@curioapps.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, Pat Lee <pat.lee@curioapps.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 17:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Curio Apps — looking for a quick demo and fit questions

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the context. A few quick clarification items so we make the demo productive: 

1) Concurrency profile: is the ~40 QPS burst sustained for more than a minute, or is it spiky (10–30s)?
2) Latency SLO: do you have a 95th percentile target (e.g., <200ms per token) for in-app responses?
3) Data: will you want Redwood to host embeddings, or do you plan to host vectors in your infra and call us for generation only?
4) Security/compliance: any specific requirements (SOC2, EU data residency, customer-managed KMS)?

For scheduling, I have three openings next week (all PST):
- Wed 9/20 10:00–10:45am
- Wed 9/20 3:00–3:45pm
- Thu 9/21 11:00–11:45am

You can also pick a slot directly here: https://calendly.com/kimberly-park/redwood-demo-30

I'll include Connor from Trials who will handle sandbox provisioning and onboarding flow. Attached a short one-pager that outlines trial limits and typical pilot setups.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf

Thanks Kim — answers inline below.

1) Concurrency: bursts are usually spiky (10–90s). We'll see short surges around product releases; sustained load above 20s is rare.
2) Latency: we'd like 95th < 300ms for the in-app chat interactions if possible.
3) Vector hosting: prefer Redwood to host embeddings for the pilot (simpler), but we may move to self-hosted vectors long term.
4) Compliance: SOC2 is sufficient for now; we're not beholden to EU residency yet.

Slot: Wed 9/20 10:00am PST works for our engineer (Pat) and me. Please send invite.

Also attaching a simple traffic sketch — should help with batching/throughput guidance.
